assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument does not record unpaid domestic work for each individual through specific questions measuring time spent or activities performed separately from main or secondary jobs. Domestic work and caregiving are only mentioned as reasons for working part-time (QC29), reasons for not seeking work (QF07), or as categories of self-perceived status (QJ01). Per the operational definition, mentioning domestic work only as a reason for working part-time/not seeking work or as a category of inactivity/status does not fulfill the indicator.
